excerpt: Many organisations are drowning in data that no-one knows what to do with and few people understand. With more than 10 years’ experience creating award-winning data-driven stories, we teach you the secrets of turning data into powerful stories that people will understand, remember and act on. In our hands-on, interactive workshop we’ll walk you through the basics of a good visualisation and the techniques we use to make information-rich charts. By the end of the workshop you’ll be making your own charts. We offer in-house workshops tailored to your needs, with real examples that have immediate impact. We also run regular public workshops where you get to meet and work with other professionals learning to improve their data storytelling skills. - • Your dashboards are being ignored - • You're struggling to get leadership to act on data - • You need your team to create reports people actually read Stop sharing boring charts in your reports and presentations. Our workshops help your team turn dull data into clear, persuasive charts and messages. - Why visualisations are often more effective than words - How to find and shape stories in your data - What chart types to use (and avoid) - Design principles for clarity and impact - How to tailor your story for your audience - Real-world examples, critiques, and hands-on practice An award-winning team Laura Grant is an award-winning data journalist who has been training people in the communications business for five years in data and visualisation skills. She is the founder and director of Media Hack Collective and the managing editor of The Outlier, South Africa’s first data-driven online publication. Alastair has been a journalist for more than 20 years. He has won more than 10 national and international awards for data storytelling and visualisation. • Daily Maverick • BusinessTech • IOL • News24 • Daily Investor • MoneyWeb • Engineering News Our workshops are designed for anyone who works with data but struggles to communicate it clearly and persuasively. You might be:- A data analyst or researcher who needs to make your findings easy to understand - A marketing or communications professional tasked with turning numbers into messages - A manager or team leader trying to explain performance metrics or data-driven decisions to stakeholders - A consultant or journalist sharing insights with clients or the public If you're presenting to your boss, across your organisation, to clients, or to the general public, this workshop will give you the tools to make your data stand out and be noticed. This workshop is ideal for teams who work with data but need to sharpen how they present it, internally and to clients or the public. If your team prepares dashboards, reports, or presentations and needs to explain numbers clearly to colleagues, clients, or leadership, we can help you.
